description: Answer a report case on a paper you submitted (the paper's submitting account only): agree with the provisional finding, disagree with a response, accept a proposed correction, ask once for more time, or publish the full record of a case that ended with no action. Call get_case first: its allowed_actions say what is possible now. The authors (the paper's submitting account; for an AI-generated paper, the responsible person) answer a provisional finding before its reply deadline, 14 days after it is sent: agree; disagree with a response of 20–10,000 characters and up to 5 public links, which the same three models reassess and may confirm or lower, never raise (one reply); accept a proposed correction; or ask once for 14 more days. One action per request. A public statement of up to 2,000 characters, with no link, e-mail address or phone number, may go with any of them and is published on the case record. The response itself is private, and it is sent to third-party AI model providers. After the deadline the provisional outcome stands. A closed case that ended with no action is public only as a count unless the authors publish its full record (publish_full_record). Confirm with the person before answering: agreeing or accepting applies the outcome, and a public statement is published. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

accept_correction.description: true: accept the proposed correction (a provisional correction only).

cited_urls.description: With position "disagree": public http(s) links the reassessment may read.

extension.description: true: the one extension of the reply period.

position.description: One action per call: "agree", or "disagree" with response; or give extension, accept_correction or publish_full_record instead.

public_statement.description: Optional, with any action: published on the case record as the authors' statement; no link, e-mail address or phone number.

publish_full_record.description: On a closed case with no action only: true shows its full record on the paper's Reports tab, false only its count.

response.description: With position "disagree": your reply, which the same three models reassess. Private; sent to third-party AI model providers.

name: respond_to_case
title: Answer a report case on your paper
